CONMED: shorter stack; Material Acquisition/Transaction costs capped at $30M; Pro Forma Adjustments capped at 15% of EBITDA net of benefits realized
Entity scope: Restricted Parties (CHWY) vs Parent Borrower and Subsidiaries (CONMED)
CHWY nets unrestricted cash inside Consolidated Total Debt definition (no $ cap in excerpt)
CONMED applies min($100M, unrestricted cash) inside leverage ratio numerator; debt definition (Funded Debt) is gross
Numerator metric: Consolidated Adjusted EBITDAR vs EBITDA
Numerator deductions differ (maintenance capex+taxes+selected RPs vs Capex)
Denominator: Consolidated Fixed Charges vs scheduled principal + net interest + capital leases
CHWY builder opens with greater-of CNI / Retained ECF / EBITDA−140% interest
FWRG opens with CNI Growth Amount gated by Total Rent Adjusted Net Leverage Ratio ≤ 4.50x plus equity contribution prongs
Cure Amount exclusion appears in both families but via different surrounding builder architecture
Same instrument: First Lien Debt requires equal/senior priority vs Secured Obligations; Senior Secured Debt requires security on material Collateral without that equal/senior filter
Both exclude Excluded Revolving Loans and inherit CTD cash netting
